fields.title: UK Flood Risk Mapping with Outdated Data
fields.deployment_context: UK flood risk assessment models used for development approvals
fields.intended_use: Predict flood risk for new property developments
fields.what_went_wrong: AI flood models used historical rainfall data that didn't account for climate change, leading to developments being approved in areas that flooded within 5 years
fields.data_issues: Historical rainfall data did not reflect changing climate patterns. Training period excluded recent extreme weather events
fields.recommendations: Regularly update training data to reflect climate change. Include extreme weather scenarios. Validate models against recent events before deployment
fields.description: Flood prediction models in the UK failed because they used outdated rainfall data, leading to homes being built in flood zones

fields.title: Amazon Deforestation Detection Missing Selective Logging
fields.deployment_context: Satellite monitoring of Amazon rainforest deforestation
fields.intended_use: Detect and measure deforestation rates using satellite imagery
fields.system_type: Computer vision model for satellite analysis
fields.what_went_wrong: AI trained to detect clear-cutting missed selective logging (where only valuable trees are removed), underreporting deforestation by up to 40% in some regions
fields.data_issues: Training data focused on obvious clear-cutting patterns. Lacked examples of subtle selective logging
fields.recommendations: Train on diverse deforestation types. Validate against ground-truth surveys. Include subtle degradation patterns in training data
fields.description: Satellite AI missed selective logging in the Amazon, underreporting deforestation by up to 40%

fields.title: Google Flood Forecasting Failures in India (2023)
fields.deployment_context: Google's AI flood alert system deployed across India
fields.intended_use: Provide early warnings for flooding events
fields.what_went_wrong: AI issued false warnings and missed actual floods in some areas because the model was trained primarily on data from rivers with different characteristics
fields.data_issues: Training data from rivers with different flow patterns, geology, and rainfall characteristics than deployment regions
fields.recommendations: Validate models across diverse geographic regions before deployment. Include local hydrological data. Test in pilot regions first
fields.description: Google's flood alerts in India failed due to training on rivers with different characteristics

fields.title: Wildlife Camera Trap AI Misidentifying Species
fields.deployment_context: Conservation camera traps deployed in Africa using North American-trained AI
fields.intended_use: Automatically identify and count wildlife species from camera trap images
fields.what_went_wrong: Conservation AI trained on North American wildlife was deployed in Africa, misidentifying species or missing animals entirely because of different lighting, vegetation, and animal appearances
fields.data_issues: Training data entirely from different continent with different species, lighting conditions, and vegetation
fields.recommendations: Never deploy models across geographic regions without retraining. Collect local training data. Test extensively before relying on automated counts
fields.description: Wildlife AI trained in North America failed when deployed in Africa due to different species and environments

fields.title: Air Quality Prediction Failing During Wildfires
fields.deployment_context: California air quality forecasting apps during wildfire season
fields.intended_use: Predict air quality levels to help people plan outdoor activities
fields.what_went_wrong: AI gave 'moderate' readings during wildfire season because the model wasn't trained on extreme smoke events, leading people to go outside during dangerous conditions
fields.data_issues: Training data lacked extreme wildfire smoke events. Model had never seen PM2.5 levels above certain threshold
fields.recommendations: Include extreme events in training data. Set hard limits for safety-critical applications. Add manual override for unprecedented conditions
fields.description: Air quality models failed during California wildfires, showing 'moderate' readings during hazardous smoke conditions

fields.title: Crop Yield Prediction Bias Against Small Farms
fields.deployment_context: Agricultural AI deployed to predict yields for food security planning in developing countries
fields.intended_use: Predict crop yields to inform food security and aid distribution
fields.what_went_wrong: AI trained on data from large industrial farms in the US performed poorly when applied to smallholder farms in developing countries, over-predicting yields and leading to inadequate food security planning
fields.data_issues: Training data only from large industrial farms with irrigation, mechanization, and soil testing. Did not represent smallholder practices
fields.recommendations: Ensure training data represents target population. Test on diverse farm sizes and practices. Validate predictions with local agricultural experts
fields.description: Agricultural AI trained on large US farms failed for smallholder farms, leading to inadequate food security planning

fields.title: Urban Heat Island Model Ignoring Informal Settlements
fields.deployment_context: City heat exposure prediction for urban planning
fields.intended_use: Identify areas at risk of dangerous heat exposure
fields.what_went_wrong: AI model used official land-use data that didn't include informal settlements/slums, missing the most vulnerable populations and showing them as 'low risk'
fields.data_issues: Official land registry data excluded informal settlements. Model didn't see densely populated areas
fields.recommendations: Validate official data against satellite imagery and surveys. Include informal settlements in urban models. Work with local communities to verify coverage
fields.description: Heat exposure AI missed slums and informal settlements, failing to identify the most vulnerable populations

fields.title: IBM Watson for Oncology Unsafe Treatment Recommendations
fields.deployment_context: Cancer treatment recommendation system deployed in hospitals globally
fields.intended_use: Assist oncologists by suggesting evidence-based treatment plans
fields.what_went_wrong: Watson recommended unsafe and incorrect cancer treatments because it was trained on a small number of synthetic cases and hypothetical patients rather than real clinical data, leading to treatment suggestions that contradicted established medical guidelines
fields.data_issues: Trained primarily on hypothetical cases curated by a small group of doctors at one institution. Did not generalise to diverse patient populations
fields.recommendations: Clinical AI must be trained and validated on real patient data from diverse populations. Independent clinical trials should be required before deployment
fields.description: IBM Watson for Oncology recommended unsafe cancer treatments after being trained on hypothetical cases instead of real patient data

fields.title: Sepsis Prediction Algorithm with High False Positive Rate
fields.deployment_context: Hospital early warning system for detecting sepsis in patients
fields.intended_use: Alert clinicians to patients at risk of developing sepsis
fields.what_went_wrong: The Epic Sepsis Model generated so many false alarms that clinicians began ignoring alerts entirely. Studies found it missed two-thirds of actual sepsis cases while creating alert fatigue among nursing staff
fields.data_issues: Model optimised for sensitivity over specificity. Did not account for the clinical cost of false positives
fields.recommendations: Balance sensitivity and specificity in clinical alerts. Measure real-world impact including alert fatigue. Involve clinical staff in threshold setting
fields.description: A widely deployed sepsis prediction model created so many false alarms that clinicians stopped trusting it, missing real cases

fields.title: COMPAS Recidivism Algorithm Racial Bias
fields.deployment_context: US criminal justice system for bail, sentencing, and parole decisions
fields.intended_use: Predict the likelihood that a defendant would re-offend
fields.what_went_wrong: ProPublica investigation revealed the algorithm was twice as likely to falsely flag Black defendants as future criminals compared to white defendants, while white defendants were more likely to be incorrectly rated as low risk
fields.data_issues: Training data reflected existing racial disparities in the criminal justice system. Historical arrest data encoded systemic bias
fields.recommendations: Audit algorithms for disparate impact across racial groups. Do not use historically biased data without correction. Ensure transparency in how risk scores are calculated
fields.description: The COMPAS algorithm used in US courts showed significant racial bias, disproportionately flagging Black defendants as high-risk

fields.title: Knight Capital Algorithmic Trading Disaster
fields.deployment_context: Automated stock trading on the New York Stock Exchange
fields.intended_use: Execute high-frequency trades automatically based on market conditions
fields.what_went_wrong: A faulty software deployment caused the system to execute millions of erroneous trades in 45 minutes, resulting in a $440 million loss and the near-bankruptcy of Knight Capital Group
fields.data_issues: Old test code was accidentally activated in production. No circuit breaker was in place to halt runaway trading
fields.recommendations: Implement kill switches for automated systems. Use staged rollouts with monitoring. Maintain strict separation between test and production code
fields.description: A software error in automated trading lost Knight Capital $440 million in 45 minutes

fields.title: Uber Self-Driving Car Fatal Pedestrian Collision
fields.deployment_context: Autonomous vehicle testing on public roads in Tempe, Arizona
fields.intended_use: Navigate public roads without human intervention
fields.what_went_wrong: The self-driving system detected the pedestrian 6 seconds before impact but classified her as an unknown object, then a vehicle, then a bicycle, never resolving what she was. The emergency braking system had been disabled
fields.data_issues: Object classification system could not handle a pedestrian walking a bicycle outside of a crosswalk. Safety driver was not paying attention
fields.recommendations: Never disable safety systems during testing. Design for edge cases. Ensure human backup operators remain attentive. Test extensively in simulation before public road deployment
fields.description: An Uber self-driving car killed a pedestrian after failing to correctly classify her as a person, with emergency braking disabled

fields.title: ChatGPT Lawyer Cites Fabricated Court Cases
fields.deployment_context: Legal brief preparation for a US federal court case
fields.intended_use: Research legal precedents to support a court filing
fields.what_went_wrong: A lawyer used ChatGPT to research case law and submitted a brief containing six completely fabricated court cases with invented citations. The judge sanctioned the lawyer after none of the cited cases could be found
fields.data_issues: LLMs generate plausible-sounding but fictitious content. No built-in mechanism to verify factual accuracy of generated legal citations
fields.recommendations: Always verify AI-generated factual claims against primary sources. Do not use LLMs as authoritative reference tools. Professionals must maintain responsibility for verifying AI outputs
fields.description: A lawyer submitted a court brief with six completely fabricated case citations generated by ChatGPT

fields.title: Amazon Hiring Algorithm Gender Discrimination
fields.deployment_context: Automated resume screening for software engineering roles at Amazon
fields.intended_use: Rank job applicants by predicted suitability for technical roles
fields.what_went_wrong: The system was trained on 10 years of resumes submitted to Amazon, which were predominantly from men. It learned to penalise resumes containing the word 'women's' and downgraded graduates of all-women's colleges
fields.data_issues: Training data reflected the existing gender imbalance in tech hiring. Historical hiring patterns encoded gender discrimination
fields.recommendations: Audit training data for demographic bias before deployment. Test for disparate impact across protected groups. Do not automate decisions that perpetuate historical discrimination
fields.description: Amazon's AI hiring tool systematically discriminated against women by learning from a decade of male-dominated hiring patterns

fields.title: Clearview AI Mass Facial Recognition Scraping
fields.deployment_context: Facial recognition service sold to law enforcement agencies worldwide
fields.intended_use: Match photos of unknown individuals against a database for identification
fields.what_went_wrong: Clearview AI scraped over 3 billion facial images from social media platforms without consent, creating a surveillance tool that was used by police, private companies, and foreign governments with no oversight or accountability
fields.data_issues: Billions of images collected without user knowledge or consent. No opt-out mechanism. Data shared with unknown third parties
fields.recommendations: Facial recognition systems must require informed consent. Governments should regulate mass biometric data collection. Individuals must have the right to know if their data is being used
fields.description: Clearview AI scraped billions of facial images from social media without consent, creating a mass surveillance tool
